faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS) for the School Of Management And Labour Studies (SMLS) project Tata Motors ERCP.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by TISS?
faq.answer: TISS has advertised for the position of Research Assistant under the project-based recruitment scheme.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for TISS Research Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 03-10-2026. Candidates must ensure they send their application before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the TISS Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Research Assistant position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs 50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a two-year Master's degree in Psychology, Business Management, Human Resource Management, or related disciplines along with a minimum of two years of research experience.

faq.question: Q6. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply by sending their updated CV, statement of interest, sample research work, and relevant certificates via email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for TISS Research Assistant?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for applying to the Research Assistant position.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for TISS Research Assistant?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises shortlisting candidates based on their CV and application documents, followed by an interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the date of the interview for shortlisted candidates?
faq.answer: The interview for the shortlisted candidates is scheduled to take place on 09 October 2026, while shortlisted candidates will be informed by 05 October 2026.

faq.question: Q10. What subject line should be used in the email application?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to use the subject line 'Application for Research Assistant – SMLS' when sending their application email.
